# MEDIASTINITIS

Mediastinitis occurs after cardiothoracic procedures or less commonly after esophageal perforation.

---

References:

- Mandell chapter: Principles and Practice of Infectious Diseases.
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment AFTER CARDIOTHORACIC SURGERY

Preferred:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R
<  >
Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R
<AND>
vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R

### Treatment AFTER ESOPHAGEAL PERFORATION OR RUPTURE

Mixed aerobic/anaerobic infection is often present.

Preferred:
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h R

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R,DI
<AND>
metronidazole 500 mg IV q12h DI

## Outpatient

### Treatment AFTER CARDIOTHORACIC SURGERY

Preferred:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R
< OR >
Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R
<AND>
vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R

### Treatment AFTER ESOPHAGEAL PERFORATION OR RUPTURE
